actual_actions.reason: Project design intent no longer treats the current v43 Prism slider/link/arm arrangement as the mechanism that must be completed. Existing v43 observations remain valid bounded evidence about one candidate pose, while mechanism selection is reopened around bottle-handling function.
The admitted zero-mate and contact-topology evidence remains relevant negative/spatial evidence and is not deleted or reinterpreted as mechanical acceptance.

conclusion: PLAN-0009 is superseded as an active investigation because binding design intent for the current Prism mechanism would prematurely constrain the design space. The current Prism fit-check remains one candidate architecture with useful admitted evidence. The governed frontier moves to function-first bottle handling: bind required bottle DOF, support, restraint, wrap contact, and state requirements before selecting or designing a mechanism.
